subject: Save rChart to png, insert into wb, and download in Shiny app - how to?

messages.author: e9ea40ad71e07dc0
messages.subject: Save rChart to png, insert into wb, and download in Shiny app - how to?
parts:
I saw the latest rChart d3Pie, it is awesome. 

Ramnath did a great job on this tutorial.
http://timelyportfolio.github.io/rChartsExtra/d3pie/

I then found this site to be extremely helpful, allows you to design a d3pie chart and generate the code. Combine this with Ramnath's explanation how the lists work in R using rCharts/d3Piews was hugely helpful in making my app look great!
http://d3pie.org/#generator

I would like to save the generated d3Pie's plot as a downloadble png and ultimately insert into an excel wb report I'm making using xlsx package. I am able to make a report with inserted ggplot, now just want to upgrade by ggplot to an d3Pie:

My code goes like this... I tried to highlight a couple things I found helpful to make it work as it does now (I'm sorry my defined functions makes it hard to read, I'm happy to try and recast it into a complete simplified version of what I'm trying to do, if someone thinks they can help)

The RAD_Org_Plot is a function that makes a ggplot, using xlsx package I can create a wb and add the plot using addPicture. One key was to use the tempfile to get it to work on the web

    outfile <- tempfile(fileext='.png')
    
    png(outfile, width=900, height=250)
    print(RAD_Org_Plot(AllSum,department=Dept,color=RAD.color))
    dev.off()
    
    addPicture(file=outfile, radsheet, scale = 1, startRow = start.row+2,startColumn = 3)


Then in my downloadhandler, I can download an excel report, one trick I found was to use the file.rename to make it work on a hosted shiny app.


output$downloadData_summary_org <- downloadHandler(
  
  filename = function() {paste(input$Org,".xlsx",sep='') },
  
  content = function(file){
    fname <- paste(file,"xlsx",sep=".")
    
    #Select Department
    model<-ID()
    table<-input$SummaryReportBox_Org
    
    #save, format, rename and download workbook
    
      saveWorkbook(
        Excel_Summary_Org(model)
        ,fname)
    file.rename(fname,file)}
  )
   
How can I create a png for download of d3Pie (then ultimately insert it into an excel wb for download)

My current research:
I was trying to make sense of the following links, is there an easy straightforward way to do this? Perhaps if someone can just help me convert an rchart into a png, I was loosely following the links below that the HTML needed to be converted into a file first (?..)

This link follows Ramnath's advice for doing it, I didn't understand what I needed to install and where, the phantomjs portion
https://github.com/Rapporter/rapport/issues/105

Ramnath's function's for doing this:
https://github.com/ramnathv/rCharts/blob/b6246d3a4a47c26a8c1023178a83a4e35959bd2c/R/makeExamples.R

This looked to be also an interesting possibility, they were able to get HighCharts to a png, by installing inkscape on the server
http://withr.me/add-an-export-module-to-shiny-app-which-creates-highcharts-figure/

My plan is to experiment with this and see if I can swap the HighChat out for d3pie
https://gist.github.com/withr/59cc48edc1658b61ea4e

The 4 links above were a bit ahead of my current understanding, I was hoping someone had a straight forward solution.

Many Thanks!
Mike
